Some {creature:Troll|Trolls} stole a {item:Fanfare} and hid it beneath Carlin's cemetery. Pick up the {item:Key 3520} near the harbour, go down into the cemetery crypt, find the hole and follow the path to the chest with the Fanfare. A simple quest, great for low-level characters.
Box with Key 3520, near the Carlin boat
for the crypt door (it may already be open)
The crypt is near the city and very busy, so the door may already be open and you may not even need the key. Still, picking up the key is quick.
Opening the chest by the boat
In **Carlin**, enter the building just **northwest** of the boat and open the chest to pick up the {item:Key 3520}.
The chest with Key 3520, in the building northwest of the boat
Enter the {wiki:Carlin Graveyard|Carlin graveyard}, just **east** of the city, and go down to the crypt at the **south** end of the graveyard.
The crypt entrance, at the south end of the graveyard
Open the door to the **west** (with the Key 3520, if it is locked) and look for a hole in the floor. Go down it.
The hole past the west door
Down there, follow the path on the map below through the cave, killing the {creature:Troll|Trolls} you meet, until you reach the chest.
The path through the Trolls' cave to the chest
Bring a {item:Rope} so you can climb back up.
Use the chest to receive the {item:Fanfare}.

Go back the same way on the map to the hole you came down through and use the {item:Rope} to climb up to the crypt again. Leave the crypt by the stairs at the **south** end of the graveyard and you are **east** of **Carlin** again ({coord:32407,31784,7}).
Also known as the *Carlin Troll Quest*.
